_doc: Revert-verify mutant for issue #4438 / ticket a3f3939c on the RESOLUTION it reuses (WikilinkValidator.targetExists). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). M3 replaces the delegation to `validateWikilink` with the hand-rolled `<uid>.md` existence check the gate must NOT be — the second existence check that would drift from the one every other reference goes through. It reds exactly the three axes that live off the delegated rules: K7 (a class whose UID exists only in frontmatter, the `exo__Asset_uid` scan fallback) and K8/K11 (a create-batch item instancing a class created by another item of the SAME batch — K8 declared earlier, K11 declared LATER, because `pendingUids` is built from the whole batch up front, so both are legal). The gate call site is pinned in create-class-resolvable-4438.create.spec.json. Recorded runs: see PR body.
